name: isPatchManagementEnabled
definition: True when operating system and software patches are applied within the organisation's policy window across the devices or servers in scope.
population: the devices or servers in scope; denominator = every device or server the read lists
evidenceRequiredForTrue: A complete read of every in-scope device or server showing patches applied within the policy window, or a passing test of the same fact over the full population.
citations: safeguards/compliancemanagement/vanta/ and safeguards/compliancemanagement/drata/ ispatchmanagementenabled.py (third-party proof sources: the GRC platform's own test result, level 3 in the proof ladder)

changeLog.change: Registered so the GRC-platform proof-source transforms can emit it. The meaning is the existing catalogue description made precise; the roughly twenty existing implementations in other categories were not reviewed, so the key stays proposed and V0.

notes: Registered for the Vanta and Drata proof-source transforms. Those answer from a GRC platform's own test results (third-party proof, level 3), never from a read of the tool, so allowedCategories is empty (cross-category evidence). Whether the other implementations of this key measure the same thing is not ruled; that review is open and the owner is not yet named.
